name: MonarchInlineNotice
title: InlineNotice
summary: A one-line message with a tone, attached to a field, a row, a card or a panel.
whenToUse: For a short status next to the thing it is about: a conflict on a form, a note under a field, a warning in a table row or a card.
whenNotToUse: For a message about a whole screen or section, use MonarchCalloutBanner or MonarchBanner. For a field error, use the error text of MonarchTextField. For a transient confirmation, use a snackbar through MonarchSnackbarHost.
api: @Composable fun MonarchInlineNotice(message: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info, variant: MonarchInlineNoticeVariant = MonarchInlineNoticeVariant.Subtle, title: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, action: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, announcement: MonarchBannerAnnouncement = MonarchBannerAnnouncement.None, toneLabel: String? = null, dismissLabel: String? = null)

options.name: tone
options.description: Neutral, Info, Success, Warning or Danger: the colors and the spoken tone name.

options.name: variant
options.description: Subtle: a tinted strip. Plain: coloured icon and text, no fill.

options.name: title
options.description: A short bold lead-in on the same line.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon at the start in the tone color. Hidden from TalkBack; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: action
options.description: One small action at the end.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Adds a dismiss button. The app removes the notice.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: The close mark of the dismiss button; without it the button shows its label as text.

options.name: announcement
options.description: None, Polite or Assertive: makes the text a live region.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: The tone name read first. null uses monarch_inlinenotice_tone_info, _success, _warning or _danger.

options.name: dismissLabel
options.description: Label or TalkBack name of the dismiss button. null uses monarch_inlinenotice_dismiss, "Dismiss".

states.name: subtle
states.description: The tinted background of the tone with default text and an icon in the strong tone color.

states.name: plain
states.description: No fill; icon and text in the strong tone color, muted text for neutral.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: A dismiss button at the end, when onDismiss is given. The app removes the notice.

states.name: announced
states.description: With Polite or Assertive the text is a live region.

appearance: Subtle: the subtle background of the tone (the muted background for neutral), 8dp corners, default text and an icon in the strong tone color. Plain: no background, text and icon in the strong tone color. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The notice does not hide itself: the app removes it in onDismiss, where the web can keep its own open state. The web live option (true picks assertive for danger) is the announcement parameter, which reuses MonarchBannerAnnouncement and is never chosen by tone. The action is a slot, as on the web; iOS takes a title and a closure. Monarch bundles no icons: the web and iOS show a default icon per tone, here the app passes one, and the dismiss button shows the word Dismiss unless a dismissIcon is given. The action stays at the end at every font size, where iOS moves it under the text. The spoken tone name comes from the shared Monarch tone names (Information, Success, Warning, Error, AI), the same words as iOS. Deprecated (D7): the component's own string keys monarch_inlinenotice_tone_info, _success, _warning and _danger are now aliases of the shared names. An app that redefines one still gets its text, but they are removed no earlier than 2027-02-13 (90-day window, two patch releases); override the shared monarch_internal_tone_* names or pass toneLabel instead.
accessibility: The tone name, title and message are one TalkBack element, read in that order; toneLabel replaces the tone name. The neutral tone has no spoken name.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack.
The action and the dismiss button are separate buttons with 48dp touch targets.
With announcement Polite or Assertive the text is a live region; by default the notice does not announce itself.
The action and the dismiss button are at the end in both layout directions; the text wraps.
edgeCases: Long text wraps; with an action and a dismiss button at the largest font size the text column gets narrow, so keep the action label short.
A plain notice has no padding, so it lines up with the field above it.

parityExceptions.reason: The dismiss button is shown when an onDismiss callback is passed, so the template passes one; there is no separate dismissible flag.
parityExceptions.convention: SwiftUI and Compose enable an optional control by passing its callback.
